dialog.description: Activity on issues in these scopes is batched into this chat for {{agent}}, who tells you only what needs you.
dialog.archived: Restore this chat to make it a Super Agent.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.picker_description: The Super Agent follows this issue and all its sub-issues.
scopes.empty: Add a project or an issue tree.
scopes.board_hint: Each project gets a board issue that records the Super Agent's runs.

batching.title: Batching
batching.invalid: Seconds must be 10–86400, the longest wait at least the quiet period, and the hourly run alert 1–60.

held.title: Items the Super Agent handled
held.empty: Appears once the Super Agent screens inbox items.

release.title: Release this Super Agent?
release.description: The chat stops receiving issue activity.
release.keep_hint: To use them again, set a chat up as a Super Agent with the same scopes; they are picked up and resumed.

board.title: Super Agent board · {{chat}}
board.description: Records the runs of the Super Agent in the chat "{{chat}}". Created by Super Agent settings.

toast.scope_taken: {{scope}} already belongs to another chat's Super Agent. Release that Super Agent or remove the scope there first.

list.empty: No Super Agents yet. To make one, open a chat's menu and choose Set as Super Agent.
list.unbound_title: Subscriptions not in a Super Agent
list.unbound_hint: Kept when a Super Agent was released. Setting a chat up as a Super Agent with the same scope picks one up again.
list.delete_description: Its captured events are deleted too.

overlap.title: Other Super Agents already receive events from these scopes
overlap.hint: Both Super Agents would act on the same issues. To add these scopes anyway, choose {{action}} again.

covering.label: Super Agent
covering.superseded: A narrower scope of this agent receives the events
